children.name: What documents are required during registration/sign up?
What if I train more than 2 teams?
How does my team get the training program from me?
I am not yet part of a regional or professional team, can I still register?
Are Parents & Stakeholders able to register for monitoring?
Still unsure? Haven't found the right question?

Yes, you can list more than one team if you are part of a regional or national team. How many teams can I register? Head coach, assistant coach, and athletes: Maximum of 3 teams (e.g., professional club, regional team, and national team).Example: Long Marine Beach Surf Club, Bali Regional Team, Indonesia National Team. Assistant coaches and part-timers: Maximum of 5 teams (professional club and regional team, if applicable).
